notes.title: Game updated to 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you all for understanding. We have fixed bugs in 1.0.4 patch. And update the game again.

Changes:

    Added skipping enemy turn
    Added scrolling screen when the mouse near to the edge of the screen
    Added the ability to sell items
    Rebalanced Generation abilities in items
    Rebalanced bosses
    Ability "Meteorite" now deals damage to enemies
    The first available game mode is now Team Fight 


Fixes:

    Filters in store
    Scroll in store
    Equipment randomly unequipped after fight
    Some missions not working
    Duplicates missions in a single battle
    Wrong mission descriptions
    Register the click on the button as a "path selection"
    Resetting market after few fights on single game session
